en.headline: A festive plush poinsettia bouquet with three detachable Micromallows
en.intro: This bouquet holds three soft, detachable 2.5-inch Micromallows (Laurel the Christmas Tree, Zumir the Peppermint Moose and Brooke the Polar Bear) among plush poinsettias and holiday goodies. Our concierge checked the listing, and we order it from the overseas seller after you place your order.
highlights: Three detachable Micromallows come with it: Laurel the Christmas Tree, Zumir the Peppermint Moose and Brooke the Polar Bear.
Each 2.5-inch plush can be displayed, swapped or played with, so the bouquet is more than a decoration.
The bouquet of plush poinsettias and holiday goodies adds a festive holiday look.
The soft Micromallows suit holding and playing as well as display.
The seller presents it as a treat for yourself or a loved one.

sections.p: The three Micromallows detach from the bouquet, so you can leave them among the poinsettias for display, swap them with other plush, or take them out to play. Each one measures 2.5 inches (about 6.4 cm).
It suits Squishmallows fans and collectors, and anyone who wants a holiday gift that is a little different from a regular bouquet. Age tags on the listing start at 3.

cautions: The 2.5-inch size refers to the Micromallows; the listing gives no size for the bouquet itself.
The listing carries age tags starting at 3.

highlights: Laurel the Christmas Tree, Zumir the Peppermint Moose, Brooke the Polar Bear 3개의 Micromallows가 분리돼요.
2.5인치 인형을 전시하거나 서로 바꿔 꽂거나 가지고 놀 수 있어서 장식으로만 끝나지 않아요.
플러시 포인세티아와 연말 소품으로 꾸민 꽃다발이라 홀리데이 분위기가 살아요.

판매처는 나 자신이나 소중한 사람을 위한 선물로 소개해요.

sections.p: Micromallows 3개는 꽃다발에서 분리되어, 포인세티아 사이에 두고 전시하거나 다른 인형과 바꾸거나 꺼내서 놀 수 있어요. 인형 하나의 크기는 2.5인치(약 6.4cm)예요.
Squishmallows를 좋아하는 분, 수집하는 분, 평범한 꽃다발과는 다른 연말 선물을 찾는 분께 잘 맞아요. 상품 정보에 3세 이상 연령 표기가 있어요.

cautions: 2.5인치는 Micromallows 인형 크기예요. 꽃다발 자체의 크기는 상품 정보에 나와 있지 않아요.
